placementplus.config.title: Placement Plus
placementplus.config.fast_placement.desc:
Fill floors and walls quickly by sweeping the crosshair while holding right-click.

While you hold right-click with a block, one is placed each time the crosshair moves onto another block (normally one every 4 ticks).

Example: look down at the floor, hold right-click and swing the view sideways; a row is placed where you swept.

So that a quick single click does not place two, it waits a moment after the click and places the swept spots once it is clear you are sweeping. More settings are on the Fast Placement tab.
placementplus.config.continuous_placemen:
Keeps placing while you hold right-click, even without moving the crosshair.

Blocks keep going in front of (toward you) or beyond the block just placed.

Example: hold it while looking at a wall and a pillar grows toward you. While bridging, the bridge shoots out the way you look.

When off, placing against the block just placed again waits until you have moved one block.
placementplus.config.fast_placement_coun: The most blocks Continuous Placement places per tick (1/20 s). Higher grows faster.
placementplus.config.keep_first_orientat:
Place stairs, slabs, logs and the like all facing the same way.

Blocks after the first in one press are placed with the first one's facing and half (top or bottom slab and so on).

Example: place one top slab, then sweep; every slab swept over is a top slab too.
placementplus.config.placement_restricti:
Limits where blocks after the first may go, by the first block and the side it was placed against. "The plane" goes through the first block, parallel to that side.

None: no limit.
Plane: only in the plane.
Same Side: only when placing against a side facing the same way.
Column: only in the column going straight out from that side.
Cross: only in the plane, in line with the first block across or along.
Layer: only within Layer Height of the first block.
Diagonal: only in the plane, on the 45° diagonals through the first block.

A key that steps through these can be assigned under Controls → Placement Plus.
placementplus.config.restriction_layer_h: With the Layer restriction, how many layers blocks may go in, counting the first block's. 1 is only the first block's height; 3 is it and the 2 above. Negative values count downward.
placementplus.config.placement_grid.desc: Only places where X, Y and Z are all a multiple of this many blocks away from the first block. 3 places every third block. 1 places everywhere.
placementplus.config.fast_placement_item:
Which blocks Fast Placement is used with. Others are placed every 4 ticks as usual.

All: every block.
All but Excluded: every block not under Excluded Items.
Included Only: only the blocks under Included Items.
placementplus.config.fast_placement_excl: Items Fast Placement is not used with, when Items is All but Excluded.
placementplus.config.fast_placement_incl: Items Fast Placement is used with, when Items is Included Only.
Each block face is split into a center and four edges. Hold one of these keys while placing (assign them under Controls → Placement Plus):

Rotate: the block is placed as if you were looking toward the edge you aim at. Aiming at the center places it as if you were looking out of the face, the opposite of usual.

Place Beside: the block goes next to the block you aim at, on the side of the edge you aim at, instead of in front of it.
placementplus.config.fake_sneak.desc: Blocks can be placed against chests, crafting tables, doors and other blocks you can use, without sneaking. To use such a block, right-click it with an empty hand or with something that is not a block.
placementplus.config.bridging.desc:
When the crosshair points at nothing while you hold a block, the empty space along your line of sight that touches a block becomes the target. The outline is on that space with Placement Preview on, or on the block it is placed against with it off. You can place against the side of the block you stand on without sneaking to its edge.

A key to turn it on and off can be assigned under Controls → Placement Plus.
Clicking the same block as the one in your hand extends the run of that block, like scaffolding: the block goes into the first free space along it.

The run goes toward the edge of the face you aim at. From the center, it goes the way you face when clicking a top or bottom, and up when clicking a side.

Not used while a Flexible Placement key is held. A key to turn it on and off can be assigned under Controls → Placement Plus.
placementplus.config.scaffold_distance.d:
How many blocks along a run of the same block, from the one clicked, Scaffold Placement looks for a free space.

A free space farther than you can reach (normally about 4.5 blocks in Survival and 5 in Creative) is not used, so larger values only matter when your reach is extended.
placementplus.config.placement_preview.d:
See where the block will go before you right-click.

When Place Beside, Scaffold Placement or Bridging would put it somewhere other than in front of the block you aim at, the block outline is moved to that spot. For an ordinary placement the outline stays on the block you aim at, as usual.

Example: when bridging, the outline is on the empty space the block goes into, not on the block you build from.
